parts.label: Part 2
parts.article:
Welcome to the tour of our gym, Nothing but Fitness. No doubt, you know a little of what our gym has to give in terms of fitness, but as you’ll discover, we have much more than just running machines and weights on offer. The gym's open from 5.30am, nice and early in the morning, to 10pm at night, so these hours give you plenty of time to fit in your workouts in our weights and cardio rooms or with your personal trainers. Now obviously, reception is open whenever the gym is. We have a childcare centre on site for mums and dads wanting to fit a workout into a busy day, but it’s only open in the mornings, so you’ll need to plan your workout around that. For those of you too busy to eat properly at home, there’s a cafe on site offering healthy and delicious meals that start serving as soon as the gym opens and doesn’t shut until we close at night. Of course, to workout comfortably, you need suitable clothing. We have a shop here for those of you who'd like to pick up some new shoes or workout gear. The staff there will be happy to kit you out from midday onwards, so do have a look at what’s on offer.

We’re a modern gym and we’re always updating our facilities. Actually, the gym's just replaced all our treadmills with the latest models, so if you’re a runner, try them out. After you’ve finished your run, you might want to improve your flexibility by taking one of our yoga classes in the comfortable yoga studio or relax in the traditional sauna. You’ll notice the change rooms when you enter the gym. They’ve just been renovated and are now very luxurious and spacious. As the gym's in the centre of the city, parking’s always a problem, even with our free passes for members. You’ll be glad to hear that an overhaul of the car park's planned for next year.

Now let’s talk about where things are. We’re standing in the entrance to the building. Some of you have meetings with your personal trainers today. To find them, walk past the right side of reception and into the Cardio studio. Their office is on the right, just after you go past the manager’s office. It’s a warm day, so why not head to the pool? The easiest way to get there is from the entrance, go round the left side of reception and into the Cardio studio and then you’ll see that the third door on the left is the way into the shop. Go into the shop and you’ll see there are two more doors. You want the one opposite you as you walk in. Go through that door and you’ll see the pool, which runs along the west side of the building. Stretching after exercise is essential, so you’ll need the stretch area. To find it, from the entrance, head to the back of the Cardio studio. You’ll see two doors facing you and it’s the one on the right.

As we’ve only got men here today, I’ll point out only where your change rooms are. From the entrance, go up the left side of the Cardio studio and you want the middle door. That’s the room just before you reach the shop. If you’re looking to bulk up, the weights room will be important. It’s easy to find. From the entrance, walk past the left side of reception and through the Cardio studio to the back of the building. The weights room is through the door on the left. The first aid room is beside it, although hopefully you won’t need to go in there. After this, you might want to have a drink in our cafe. Go to the shop and this time take the door to your right, not the one opposite, and this leads to the cafe with a nice view of the river.

questions.question: Which TWO parts of the gym are closed for part of the day?

analyses.content: 原文提到托儿中心只在**早上（only open in the mornings）**开放，所以它不是全天开放。
Speaker: We have a childcare centre on site... but it’s only open in the mornings, so you’ll need to plan your workout around that.
原文说 "reception is open whenever the gym is"（前台随健身房全天开），排除 C。

questions.question: Which TWO parts of the gym are closed for part of the day?

analyses.content: Speaker: The staff there [the shop] will be happy to kit you out from midday onwards.
原文说 Cafe 从健身房开门一直开到关门（start serving as soon as the gym opens and doesn’t shut until we close），排除 A。
商店的工作人员从**中午开始（from midday onwards）**才提供服务，意味着上午是关闭的。

questions.question: Which TWO facilities have recently been updated?

analyses.content: Speaker: You’ll notice the change rooms when you enter the gym. They’ve just been renovated and are now very luxurious and spacious.
原文提到桑拿（sauna）是 "traditional"（传统的），未提及更新，排除 B。
原文明确提到更衣室刚刚翻新过（just been renovated），现在非常奢华宽敞。

questions.question: Which TWO facilities have recently been updated?

analyses.content: Speaker: Actually, the gym's just replaced all our treadmills with the latest models, so if you’re a runner, try them out.
原文提到停车场（car park）的翻修计划是在明年（planned for next year），排除 D。
健身房刚刚把所有的跑步机都换成了最新型号（replaced all our treadmills with the latest models）。
Speaker: Their office is on the right, just after you go past the manager’s office.
地图中 Manager's office 上方的房间是 F。
穿过前台右侧进入有氧工作室（Cardio studio），他们的办公室在右边，就在经理办公室（manager’s office）之后。
进入商店（Shop）后，穿过**正对面（opposite you）的门，就能看到位于建筑物西侧（west side）**的游泳池。
Speaker: You want the one opposite you as you walk in. Go through that door and you’ll see the pool, which runs along the west side of the building.
进入 Shop（从右往左进），正对面的门通向 G。且地图上 G 位于最左侧（West），符合描述。A 虽然也在左侧，但下文提到它是 Cafe。
Speaker: You’ll see two doors facing you and it’s the one on the right.
Cardio studio 后墙有 B 和 C 两扇门，右边的是 C。
从入口走到有氧工作室（Cardio studio）的后面（back），你会看到两扇门，**右边（on the right）**的那扇就是伸展区。
Speaker: From the entrance, go up the left side of the Cardio studio and you want the middle door.
左侧墙面有 I, H, 和通向 Shop 的门。H 是中间的，且在 Shop 之前。
沿着有氧工作室的左侧（left side）走，你要找的是中间那扇门（middle door），就在到达商店之前。
Speaker: ...to the back of the building. The weights room is through the door on the left.
后墙有 B 和 C，左边的是 B（C 是 Q17 的 Stretch area）。
穿过有氧工作室走到建筑物的后面（back），举重室是**左边（on the left）**的那扇门。
Speaker: Go to the shop and this time take the door to your right... and this leads to the cafe with a nice view of the river.
在 Shop 里向右转（即向地图上方走），通向 A。地图显示 A 紧邻河流（River），符合 "view of the river"。
走进商店（Shop），这次走**右边（to your right）**的门，通向可以看到河景的咖啡馆。
